source.name: PRS Legislative Research MP Track
source.collection_method: profile page extraction with cached HTML responses (scripts/02_fetch_prs.py --state goa)
source.discovery: Profile URLs taken from the PRS MP Track 18th Lok Sabha directory (data/raw/prs.india.manifest.2026-10-31.json, crawled from https://prsindia.org/mptrack/18-lok-sabha) and confirmed against each fetched page's og:url, State and Constituency fields.
